protocol.checkpoint_selection: independent synthetic-validation-best checkpoints; EventGenesis epoch 33/update 6534 and V2E epoch 20/update 3960. Epochs and scheduler boundaries are validated per arm; equal update/epoch is not required.
protocol.rollouts: all eight fixed held-out synthetic validation rollouts

regions.shared_event_active_union: flow_valid AND spatial pixels with any nonzero value in either generator's paired 5-bin event representation; one union mask for both predictions
regions.gt_motion_ge_0_5: flow_valid AND GT vector magnitude >=0.5 px per 30ms interval
regions.gt_motion_ge_1_0: flow_valid AND GT vector magnitude >=1.0 px per 30ms interval

protocol.direction_statistics: on each fixed GT-motion region; direction is reported only where predicted magnitude >=0.1 px per 30ms
protocol.metric_aggregation: pixel pooled within each stratum and across the fixed diagnostic sample; official checkpoint selection metric is unchanged
protocol.model_input: event volume only; grayscale endpoint images are checked for pairing/timing but are not passed to the model
protocol.output_contract: STE output [1,2,352,352], remove registered padding y=46:306 and x=3:349, preserve u/v pixel displacement per 30ms interval without vector rescaling

model_source_hashes.augmentation: unchanged: pixel-center normalized grid with align_corners=False

dataset_and_label_checks.flow_direction: forward physical projection from event_start_s to label_time_s=event_end_s
dataset_and_label_checks.event_window_rule: (t_i,t_i+3] on shared 100Hz endpoints; starts at i=0,3,...,195; the remaining 20ms of each 2s rollout is excluded by the registered 66-window count

interpretation_limits: This is a fixed-sample synthetic diagnostic, not a real-data score or generator ranking.
Event activity is measured after the accepted five-bin representation and may include its spatial Gaussian support.
Direction metrics omit predictions below 0.1 px per interval because their angle is numerically uninformative; their share is reported separately.
